name: Industrialist
desc:
Industrialist is a factory construction and expansion game inspired by Mindustry, Factorio, and other popular industry simulation games.

Key Game Features:
    • Pollution management: Keep track of your pollution level and keep it under control.
    • Production lines: Plan, optimize, and upgrade your manufacturing systems.
    • Economic strategy: Manage money and research new technology.
    • Immersive mechanics: Engage with immersive and modular machine systems.

This game has a steep learning curve and complex mechanics. Getting used to these systems will require a lot of practice, so we recommend playing with friends to share discoveries.

Development Status:
Beta (v1.0). Expect regular updates, possible bugs, and changes while the game is in development.

scripts.title: OP AI Helper Bot (Keyless/OpenSource)
scripts.features:
This is made with AI, hence why it's open source.

Features:

AI & Live Chat: Real-time AI status dashboard, query monitor, conversation controls, and filtered chat event logs.

Players & Stats: Tracks LocalPlayer stats (FPS, Ping, Memory, Health, Position) and monitors overall session usage metrics.

Factory AI & Calculators: Natural-language tools for production chains, bottleneck fixes, power/pollution planning, and ratio calculations.

Knowledge & Actions: Grounded Industrialist wiki data plus player navigation via Instant Teleportation or Noclip Tweening.

Settings & Help: API key setup, model picker, prefix customizer (!help), and dynamic usage examples.

This script may not work well with low UNC executors.

Made By Flashy Studios.

UI Credits: https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI

Open-Source Link: https://github.com/flashyshadowstrike/Flashy-Hub/blob/main/UniversalScripts/IndustrialistAI

scripts.title: OP Script Keyless (10+ Features)
scripts.features:
Not really supported for mobile.
(Can do logic, wiring, piping)

Features:
Copy & Paste — Copy selected builds and place them elsewhere.
Mass Delete — Delete multiple objects at once, even without mass deletion perm.
Replace — Replace selected objects with another object (replacing pipe with fluid pipe).
Drag Select — Select large areas of objects quickly.
Save — Save copied builds and selections, you can share it with other people in the discord.
Library — Store and manage saved builds in your executor's folder.
Undo — Revert previous actions.
Player Tools — Additional player utilities (fly, speed, anti-fling, etc...)
Settings — Configure script options and behavior.
After Copy — Configure what happens after copying.
Copy Code — Generate/copy build data.

May not work well with Xeno and Solara.

Made by Flashy Studios.
Credits for UI: Fluent Modded (https://github.com/StyearX/Fluent-modded)

scripts.title: Clear pollution and antiafk
scripts.features:
its not that useful but like uh I needed to post something

been playing this game to much
scripts.script:
local antiafk =  true	

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local vu = game:GetService("VirtualUser")

player.Idled:Connect(function()
	if not antiafk then return end

    vu:CaptureController()
    vu:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
end)

-- == --

local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local atmosphere = lighting.PollutionAtmosphere
local pcolor = lighting.PollutionColorCorrection

local white = function()
	return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
end

local c1; c1 = atmosphere:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Density"):Connect(function()
	atmosphere.Density = 0
end); atmosphere.Density = 0
local c2; c2 = pcolor:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TintColor"):Connect(function()
	pcolor.TintColor = white()
end); pcolor.TintColor = white()
local c3; c3 = lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OutdoorAmbient"):Connect(function()
	lighting.OutdoorAmbient = white()
end); lighting.OutdoorAmbient = white()
